raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions loads both without normalizing. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time before deriving txn_date should move the shifted rows back to their correct business dates and clear the 00:00-06:00 and 2026-01-19 anomalies.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED');"}}
